刊物（可數）；發表；公布（不可數）

usage.label: in observance of the holiday
usage.explanationZh: 慶祝節日；= in celebration of the holiday。

usage.label: sb demand / require / request that S (+ should) + V
refer to the dictionary / phone book
usage.explanationZh: 查字典／電話簿；= consult the dictionary / phone book。

usage.label: make reference to...
usage.explanationZh: 提到；言及……；= refer to...；= mention...。

usage.label: Under no circumstances + 倒裝句
usage.explanationZh: 絕不……；= By no means / In no way / On no account + 倒裝句。

usage.label: in all aspects
usage.explanationZh: 在各方面；= in every aspect。

usage.label: consist of...
usage.explanationZh: 由……組成；= be made up of...；= be composed of...。

usage.label: be consistent with...
usage.explanationZh: 與……一致／沒有矛盾；= be in accord with...；= correspond with...。

usage.label: have a tendency to + V
usage.explanationZh: 有……的傾向；= tend to + V。

usage.label: contribute to...
usage.explanationZh: 導致……；= lead to...；= result in...；= give rise to...；= bring about...。

usage.label: otherwise 與 or
usage.explanationZh: 均表「否則」；or 是連接詞、之前置逗點，otherwise 是副詞、之前置分號，用以連接兩個主要子句。

usage.label: have a capacity of + 數字
in one's capacity as + 職位
take measures
usage.explanationZh: 採取措施；= take action；= take steps。

usage.label: refer, referred, referred
usage.explanationZh: refer 的過去式與過去分詞都雙寫 r。

usage.label: look up sth
usage.explanationZh: 查某事物，以被查的對象作受詞。
